description: Read-only query of LambdaTest automation resources: list builds, get one build, list the sessions in a build, fetch test details, and retrieve test logs (command, network, console, selenium, instrumentation). Every combination works on platform "web" or "app": build list or get, session list or get, test get, and logs get with a logType. List results carry a pagination object; trust it, not result_set.total, which also counts older builds the list no longer returns. logType "instrumentation" returns XCUI and Espresso test logs. Renaming, stopping and deleting builds are separate tools: updateBuild, stopBuild and deleteBuild.

action.description: The read to perform: list, or get one

buildId.description: Build ID — required for build get, optional filter for session list

fromdate.description: Filter builds from this date (YYYY-MM-DD, a real calendar date)

limit.description: Number of results to return, 1 to 100

logType.description: Log type — required when resource is "logs"

offset.description: Offset for pagination; pass the next offset from a previous response

pageNumber.description: Page number for command log pagination, from 1

platform.description: The platform type: "web" for browser automation, "app" for mobile app automation

sessionId.description: Session ID: required for session get and for app platform log retrieval. Session get also accepts the test ID instead.

testId.description: Test ID — required for test get and logs get

todate.description: Filter builds to this date (YYYY-MM-DD, not before fromdate)

name: automationQuery
title: Automation Query
